description.value: Ho Yuen Cafe is a traditional Hong Kong-style cafe (bing sutt) in Vancouver's Westside, rooted in over six decades of family history that began as a humble noodle stall at the foot of Lion Rock in Kowloon. The Vancouver location features an in-house artisanal bakery alongside a full menu of pastries, breakfast, and lunch dishes blending Eastern and Western culinary traditions. It is a second-generation family operation carrying an award-winning Hong Kong legacy to a neighbourhood enclave on the city's south side.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM address (#113-1750 West 75th Avenue, Vancouver, BC V6P 6G2) and hours. The site's Terms & Conditions and Online Order section confirm takeout/pickup is available. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or Wi-Fi anywhere on the site or in OSM tags; the (226) area code on the phone number is Ontario-based, which is unusual for a Vancouver business and worth flagging.
concerns: OSM note reads 'Soft-Opened for test run. Checked January 2023.' — the business appears fully operational by 2026 based on website copyright and active online ordering, but the soft-open flag in OSM has not been updated.

Phone number (226) 368-3891 uses a 226 area code (Ontario/Waterloo region), which is atypical for a Vancouver business. May be a personal cell number. OSM had no phone listed, so this is unconfirmed against OSM.
OSM phone field is empty; phone sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating business with a live website (copyright 2026), online ordering, and confirmed address. A convenient stop for touring cyclists in Vancouver's Westside for pastries and a full cafe menu.
